title: Unreal Raspberry Blue 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Unreal Raspberry’s ‘Blue’ is quite possibly Blue Raspberry flavour in its purest, most delicious form. Rich blueberries and tangy-sweet raspberries combine to make a mouth-watering flavour that almost impossible to resist. This product contains 100ml of e-liquid in a 120ml shortfill bottle, with space for 2 x 10ml nicotine shots to let you tailor your juice’s nicotine content. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. The e-liquid’s 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , mods and sub-ohm tanks .
